title: Engagement
description: An engagement is a bounded body of professional work a firm performs for a client over a period - for example a tax-year return, a monthly-bookkeeping arrangement, or an advisory project. It is the top-level container that close checklists, tax-prep workflows, and request lists hang from.

clientId.description: Identifier of the client this engagement is for.

title.description: Human-readable engagement title, e.g. "2025 Form 1120 - Acme Holdings".

status.description: Lifecycle state of the engagement as a whole.

period.description: The reporting period the engagement covers (e.g. the tax year or the close month range).

engagementLetterId.description: Optional reference to the engagement-letter configuration that governs this engagement.

completedAt.description: Timestamp the engagement was completed/sealed. Present only when status is completed.
